newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 1,505,700 MT -- a marketing-year high -- tripled the week earlier and were 96 percent higher than the four-week average.

Major increases were reported for Japan (453,700 MT, reflecting 520,100 MT in new sales and 66,400 MT in cancellations), unknown destinations (393,000 MT), South Korea (162,700 MT, reflecting 112,900 MT in new sales, 52,500 in destination changes and 2,600 cancellations), Taiwan (159,400 MT, reflecting 161,400 MT in new sales, 54,000 in destination changes and 56,000 cancellations), and Spain (131,100 MT).

Exports of 1,010,900 MT were 9 percent below the previous week, but 6 percent over the 4-week average. The principal destinations were South Korea (270,900 MT), Japan (227,000 MT), Taiwan (188,400 MT), Saudi Arabia (58,700 MT), and Mexico (42,900 MT).
